info.name: Search for records matching specific criteria.

params.name: query
params.description: Filter the records using the supplied terms.

params.name: recordTypes
params.description: Restrict the search to the specified main type(s) of records.

params.name: types
params.description: Restrict the search to the specified type(s) of records.

params.name: discussionID
params.description: Set the scope of the search to the comments of a discussion. Incompatible with recordType and type.

params.name: categoryID
params.description: Set the scope of the search to a specific category (includes results from the social group category).

params.name: categoryIDs
params.description: Set the scope of the search to specific categories.

params.name: followedCategories
params.description: Set the scope of the search to followed categories only.

params.name: includeChildCategories
params.description: Search the specified category's subtree. Works with categoryID

params.name: includeArchivedCategories
params.description: Allow search in archived categories.

params.name: knowledgeBaseID
params.description: Filter the records by KnowledgeBase ID

params.name: knowledgeCategoryIDs
params.description: Filter the records by KnowledgeCategory ID

params.name: name
params.description: Filter the records by matching part of their name.

params.name: featured
params.description: Filter the records by their featured status.

params.name: locale
params.description: Filter the records by their locale.

params.name: siteSiteSectionGroup
params.description: Filter the records by their site-section-group.

params.name: insertUserNames
params.description: Filter the records by inserted user names.

params.name: insertUserIDs
params.description: Filter the records by inserted userIDs.

params.name: dateInserted
params.description: Filter by insert date. See [date filters](https://docs.vanillaforums.com/help/apiv2/date-filters/).

params.name: tags
params.description: Filter discussions by matching tags.

params.name: tagOperator
params.description:
Tags search condition.
Must be one of: "and", "or".

params.name: queryOperator
params.description: Set the default search type.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number. See [Pagination](https://docs.vanillaforums.com/apiv2/#pagination).

params.name: limit
params.description: Desired number of items per page.

params.name: expandBody
params.description: Expand the results to include a rendered body field.

params.name: expand
params.description: Expand associated records using one or more valid field names. A value of "all" will expand all expandable fields.

params.name: includeTypeaheads
params.description: BETA: Include typeahead results in the search response.

params.name: includeResults
params.description: BETA: Include search results in the search response.

params.name: statusID
params.description: Filter the records statusID

params.name: answerStatusID
params.description: Filter answer-type comments by answer statusID. Be sure it add a `types` filter if you only want answers.

params.name: postTypeID
params.description: Filter the records postTypeID

params.name: postMeta
params.description: Post meta values to filter posts

params.name: fields
params.description: Only return fields with these keys from the output. Use dot notation for nested fields.

items.docs: Search for records matching specific criteria.
